summary: Flathead NF lookout on Green Mountain, Flathead County, MT: pole L-4 tower c.1936, destroyed 1975; no source found describing the site today.

facts.design: pole L-4 tower, listed at 10 ft by firelookout.com
facts.status_note: Destroyed 1975 per firelookout.com and Rex's page; FFLA index lists Tower Gone

events.note: Pole L-4 tower on the north summit, dated 1936 by firelookout.com and c.1936 by Rex's page
Coast and Geodetic Survey described a Forest Service lookout house at the site

evidence.supports: pole L-4 tower atop the north summit, 1936
evidence.quote: 1936: 10' pole L-4 tower atop north summit.

evidence.supports: c.1936 pole tower at north summit
evidence.quote: c.1936: 10' pole tower at north summit.

evidence.supports: 1940 survey refers to a Forest Service lookout house
evidence.quote: GREEN MOUNTAIN FOREST SERVICE LOOKOUT HOUSE IS IN THE FLATHEAD
DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1940 (ANS)

evidence.supports: northeast of the Spotted Bear Ranger Station
evidence.quote: MILES NE OF THE SPOTTED BEAR RANGER STATION, 10 MILES SW OF

evidence.supports: about seven and a half miles away
sharp, timbered, bare-topped peak in the 1940 survey
evidence.quote: ON A SHARP TIMBERED, BARE-TOPPED PEAK

notes_for_editor: Two independent history pages agree on c.1936 and 1975, though both draw on the same local researcher (Kresek) for those dates. The 10 ft figure is unexplained (cab or tower height?), so no height_m. No source found describes the remains or public access today; two WebSearch calls turned up nothing about the site now. No staffing names in any source read.
